name: NXUSD
oneLiner: NXUSD is a Nereus Finance overcollateralized CDP issued on Avalanche and Polygon; the token has shown a sustained soft-depeg pattern between $0.95 and $1.01.
collateral: Overcollateralized Nereus Finance lending positions, primarily Avalanche ecosystem crypto collateral
pegMechanism: Borrowed stablecoin minted against overcollateralized deposits in Nereus markets and repaid or liquidated through protocol rules

oracleRisk.summary: NXUSD's 17 debt-bearing Avalanche Cauldrons use collateral-specific Chainlink, LP, TWAP, or staking-rate oracle routes without a common freshness check or alternate provider; a false oracle result preserves the Cauldron's cached rate, while a reverting route blocks the update.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 data research
branchApplicability.rationale: The pinned Nereus Avalanche deployment manifest contains 17 Cauldrons, and all 17 retained nonzero totalBorrow at finalized block 90297313. They share the Cauldron liquidation engine but have distinct collateral, oracle, LTV, and liquidation-multiplier configurations, so the live set is represented as one fully enumerated common-engine branch rather than inferred from the protocol-level Chainlink announcement.

branches.fallbackBehavior: Nereus oracle wrappers generally read Chainlink latestAnswer or latestRoundData without checking updatedAt, answeredInRound, or a heartbeat, and there is no alternate provider. Cauldron updateExchangeRate keeps its prior cached rate only when oracle.get returns false, as the xJOE TWAP can before initialization or its 10-minute period; an oracle revert propagates and blocks the operation. Owner-swappable ProxyOracle implementations are administrative replacements, not automatic failover.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Any caller can immediately liquidate one or more users after updateExchangeRate and the Cauldron solvency check fail. The liquidator repays each selected NXUSD debt part and receives the corresponding BentoBox collateral shares using that market's liquidation multiplier; optional callback data supports atomic liquidation execution.
branches.backstop: The reviewed deployments and Cauldron source define no Stability Pool, insurance pool, or automatic protocol-funded shortfall backstop. Liquidation depends on an external caller supplying NXUSD in exchange for seized collateral.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: The Cauldron subtracts only the borrow parts selected and repaid by a successful liquidation. Debt that is not economically liquidated remains assigned to borrower positions and continues accruing; the reviewed source defines no global settlement or automatic write-off. The NXUSD owner Safe retains a rate-limited direct mint path, but that privilege is not an automatic bad-debt mechanism.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified 2026-08-08 at Avalanche block 92344314 and Polygon block 91674352. Avalanche NXUSD remained a direct non-proxy deployment owned by the reviewed 2-of-3 Safe; its exact verified source exposes ordinary ERC-20 transfers, owner-only mint/mintToBentoBox, and self-only burn, with no pause, blacklist, freeze, seizure, or privileged holder burn. Polygon NXUSDV2 remained a direct deployment owned by 0xc4eca7d55db3dc217a2edfff3da05fca4d8a7ef8 and likewise exposes owner-gated mint/burn without a holder restriction. The prior inherited value was invalid because NXUSD has no variantOf or mintAuthority.inheritedFrom parent. Circle can freeze USDC collateral in a Nereus cauldron, but that is backing impairment rather than direct authority over NXUSD balances, so the direct verdict is false.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: GPT SOL-CORP-C wave6; Kimi T57 wave-2 re-verification

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Nereus issued distinct owner-mintable NXUSD contracts on Avalanche and Polygon. No lockbox or third-party bridge contract was identified, so the two deployments are treated as issuer-native issuance rather than one bridged token.

reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-08-08: Nereus still describes NXUSD as an overcollateralized borrow against crypto collateral in its Avalanche and Polygon lending markets. docs.nereus.finance now redirects to the marketing landing page, and neither the landing page nor the pinned GitHub deployment manifest publishes a reconciled, dated per-market collateral inventory or weights. The envelope therefore remains one aggregate classified basket rather than invented weights. The curated-validated adapter probes live token supply and carries this reviewed composition into runtime scoring.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Nereus protocol documentation; per-market collateral weights are undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current per-market collateral balances and weights across Nereus lending markets are not published; the aggregate basket cannot be split into reviewed constituents.

notices.title: Sustained soft depeg
notices.message: NXUSD has shown a sustained soft-depeg pattern, with extended periods between $0.95 and $1.01 on CoinGecko/DefiLlama feeds. Treat collateral classification as advisory rather than live redemption assurance.

mintAuthority.summary: NXUSD is a BoringOwnable CDP stablecoin; mint() is onlyOwner. The owner is a Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 with 2-of-3 threshold on Avalanche — no modules, no guard — that administers the NXUSD token and Nereus CDP parameters.

mintIncidents.summary: A flash-loan manipulation of the AVAX/USDC JLP collateral price let an attacker borrow far more NXUSD than justified by collateral, creating about $500K of NXUSD bad debt.

sources.label: Financial Express - Nereus NXUSD bad debt

controls.label: Nereus NXUSD owner multisig (2/3 Gnosis Safe)
controls.capDescription: NXUSD uses BoringOwnable; mint() rate-limits to 15% of total supply per 24h window.
controls.evidence: At Avalanche block 90243848, NXUSD owner() remained Safe 0xdd3de3b819edd3a014fda93868d7dfc873341467. The Safe was 2-of-3 with no modules, zero guard and module guard, fixed singleton 0xfb1bffc9d739b8d520daf37df666da4c687191ea, and standard CompatibilityFallbackHandler 0x017062a1de2fe6b99be3d9d37841fed19f573804. NXUSD is a direct 5007-byte deployment whose EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots were all zero. Verified source shows mint() is onlyOwner with a 15% per-24h rate limiter.

review.evidence: At Avalanche block 90243848, NXUSD was a direct 5007-byte deployment with zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots. Its onlyOwner mint path remained controlled by Safe 0xdd3de3b819edd3a014fda93868d7dfc873341467, still 2-of-3 with no modules or guard. The Safe can operate minting and CDP parameters but cannot replace the deployed NXUSD bytecode.
